title: 英国央行行长开口：市场押注三次加息，他只认一次？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Governor, thank you so much for speaking to us today. I want to ask you about market pricing because investors are really taking this very hawkish hike, pricing three further hikes.
segments.zh: 行长，感谢您今天接受采访。我想问您关于市场定价的问题，因为市场参与者确实把这次非常鹰派的加息当回事，定价了三次进一步加息。

segments.en: And actually, I know you pushed back earlier this year and saying that the peak, I mean, what we're looking at in terms of peak is maybe 4.75% and you pushed back against that earlier this
segments.zh: 实际上，我知道您在今年早些时候反驳过，说峰值，我的意思是，我们看到的峰值可能是4.75%，而您今年早些时候反驳了这一点。

segments.en: year. Is now 4.75 a possibility? So when we, when we talk to markets and when we do us, we do a survey of markets where every time we meet. And we ask them explicitly this,
segments.zh: 那么现在4.75%是一个可能性吗？当我们与市场沟通时，当我们做调查时，我们每次会议都会对市场进行调查。我们明确地问他们这个问题，

segments.en: a question which tries to, in a sense, get under the lid of this thing and basically tries to split out what is their sort of, if you like, their sort of central expectation of what they
segments.zh: 这个问题试图在某种意义上揭开这件事的盖子，基本上试图区分出他们的，如果你愿意的话，他们对我们将采取什么行动的核心预期，

segments.en: think we will do and then compare that with how they're pricing. And we sort of tend to regard
segments.zh: 然后将其与他们的定价进行比较。我们倾向于将这两个数字之间的差异视为风险溢价。

segments.en: the difference between those two numbers as the risk premium. I mean, it's an imprecise science. What we get back is broadly, they think probably there's another one in there.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，这是一门不精确的科学。我们得到的反馈大致是，他们认为可能还有一次加息。

segments.en: I'm not endorsing that by the way, just to be really clear, but that's what they think.
segments.zh: 顺便说一句，我并不是在认可这一点，只是为了明确说明，但这就是他们的想法。

segments.en: And so there is then a risk premium which to your numbers, you know, would explain the rest.
segments.zh: 因此，存在一个风险溢价，用你的数字来说，可以解释其余部分。

segments.en: Now, I don't think that's surprising or implausible because we're living in a hugely uncertain time. So the fact that we've got a bigger risk premium, which it looks like we have if you
segments.zh: 现在，我不认为这令人惊讶或不可信，因为我们生活在一个高度不确定的时代。因此，我们有一个更大的风险溢价，如果我们对此进行时间序列分析，看起来确实如此，

segments.en: sort of do the time series on this thing, well, you know, is it a surprise given that we're living
segments.zh: 那么，考虑到我们生活的时代，这难道令人惊讶吗？
